We started xiQ to answer the question:

how can we help the whole sales organization perform like the top 3%, every day?
While most sales best practices focus on the salespeople, xiQ’s Personality-Driven Sales and Marketing platform focuses on the most important part any sales process – the buyer.

xiQ offers a revolutionary methodology that combines IQ and EQ using innovative AI to deliver personality-driven tips, triggers, and tailored content right to your team’s fingertips.
